projection: max over the slab of level-0 uint8 voxels per canvas px
display: per tile: hercules.display.builder.linear_window_ct (linear 1-99 % np.percentile) over mesh-valid canvas px with slab max > 0; 0 outside mesh-valid and where max == 0 (DECL-P4-5-A1 rule); cv2.INTER_AREA 8343 -> 1068; uint8 PNG IHDR/IDAT/IEND
raw_store: unstretched slab max (uint8 8343 x 8343, key 'max') and mesh-valid mask (key 'valid') per tile, np.savez_compressed; kept in the builder container at /work/l2/raw (too large for git, ~41 MB each); sha256 of the npz bytes and of the raw max array bytes recorded per tile
